source_documents.title: Se din årsopgørelse
source_documents.body: Citizen guidance describing the annual tax assessment as the final overview of last year's income, deductions, tax paid, refund, or residual tax. It says the 2025 årsopgørelse is available from 23 March 2026 and that taxpayers must check and correct information.

source_documents.title: Årsopgørelse/Oplysningsskema
source_documents.body: Guidance explaining that the annual statement or information form is based on reported data from employers, banks, mortgage lenders, unions, and unemployment funds. The taxpayer remains responsible for missing or wrong income and deductions.

source_documents.title: Se og ret dine gamle årsopgørelser
source_documents.body: Citizen guidance for correcting older annual tax assessments. The 2025 assessment can be corrected until 1 May 2029, 2024 until 1 May 2028, 2023 until 1 May 2027, and 2022 until 1 May 2026. Later corrections generally require special circumstances and documentation.

source_documents.title: Bundskat, mellemskat, topskat og toptopskat
source_documents.body: Current 2026 guidance for Danish state income tax layers. It lists bundskat, mellemskat, topskat, and toptopskat with thresholds based on personal income after labour market contribution for higher brackets.

source_documents.title: Beskæftigelses- og jobfradrag
source_documents.body: Citizen guidance for employment and job deductions. For 2026 it lists the employment deduction rate and cap, the job deduction rate, threshold and cap, plus special senior and single-parent employment deduction amounts.

source_documents.title: Kørselsfradrag
source_documents.body: Citizen guidance for commuting deduction. It explains that annual statement rubrik 51 and preliminary assessment field 417 are used, that the taxpayer must enter actual commuting days, and it lists 2026 kilometre rates and exclusions.

source_documents.title: Arbejdsrelaterede rejsefradrag
source_documents.body: Citizen guidance for work travel deductions. It links annual statement rubrik 53 and preliminary assessment field 429, lists 2026 caps and standard rates, and describes conditions for temporary work location, distance, overnight stay, and employer reimbursement.

source_documents.title: Generelle betingelser for håndværkerfradrag og servicefradrag
source_documents.body: Citizen guidance for service and crafts deductions. It states that only labour costs qualify, the person must be at least 18 and tax-liable in Denmark, payment must be digital, and documentation is required.

source_documents.title: Beløbsgrænser i skattelovgivningen der reguleres efter personskattelovens § 20 - 2026-2027
source_documents.body: Skatteministeriet's table of amount limits in Danish tax law indexed under personskattelovens § 20, showing 2026 and 2027 values. The 2027 regulation is 2.9 percent (index 137.3 to 141.3); amounts are rounded up to the nearest 100 kr. unless stated otherwise. 2027 values include personfradrag 55.700 kr., mellemskattegrænse 659.900 kr., bundfradrag for positiv nettokapitalindkomst 56.600 kr., topskattegrænse 800.500 kr., toptopskattegrænse 2.668.200 kr., progressionsgrænse for aktieindkomst 89.600 kr., maksimalt beskæftigelsesfradrag 65.200 kr., jobfradrag bundgrænse 242.100 kr. and maksimum 3.200 kr., rejsefradrag loft 35.400 kr., servicefradrag 18.800 kr., grøn istandsættelse 9.200 kr., aktiesparekonto værdigrænse 179.300 kr. and fradrag for gaver til almenvelgørende institutioner 20.500 kr. Percentage rates are not part of the table. The table also lists the 2026 values, including personfradrag 54.100 kr., progressionsgrænse for aktieindkomst 79.400 kr., aktiesparekonto værdigrænse 174.200 kr. and fradrag for gaver til almenvelgørende institutioner 20.000 kr.

source_documents.title: Livsvarig livrente
source_documents.body: Citizen guidance for lifetime annuity pension contributions. It lists the 2026 and 2025 amount that is automatically transferred to the annual tax assessment and says higher payments must be reported by the taxpayer to claim deduction.

rules.title: Årsopgørelsen is the final annual tax result
rules.summary: The annual tax assessment shows last year's income, deductions, paid tax, and whether the taxpayer receives a refund or owes residual tax. Most information is pre-filled, but the taxpayer must check it and correct missing or wrong entries.
rules.applies_to: Individuals who receive an annual tax assessment for the previous income year.
rules.caveats: The tool can help explain fields and rules, but actual changes must be made in TastSelv or through the official process.

rules.title: Correction deadlines for older årsopgørelser
rules.summary: Older annual tax assessments can usually be corrected in TastSelv until the ordinary deadline. The listed deadlines include 2025 until 1 May 2029, 2024 until 1 May 2028, 2023 until 1 May 2027, and 2022 until 1 May 2026.
rules.applies_to: Taxpayers who discover missing income, missing deductions, or wrong amounts in prior-year assessments.
rules.source_title: Se og ret dine gamle årsopgørelser
rules.caveats: After the ordinary deadline, correction generally requires special circumstances and documentation.

rules.title: State income tax brackets and personfradrag for 2026
rules.summary: From 2026, Danish state income tax guidance distinguishes bundskat, mellemskat, topskat, and toptopskat. Higher bracket thresholds are based on personal income after labour market contribution.
rules.applies_to: Individuals with taxable personal income in Denmark in 2026.
rules.caveats: Municipal tax and church tax are separate. The CLI stores the official guidance thresholds; it does not compute full tax.

rules.title: Employment and job deductions for 2026
rules.summary: People with labour-market-contribution liable salary or business surplus receive employment and job deductions automatically. The employment deduction is percentage-based with a cap; the job deduction is calculated on income above a threshold with a cap.
rules.applies_to: Taxpayers with AM-bidragspligtig salary or business surplus.
rules.caveats: These deductions are normally calculated automatically from reported income.

amounts.label: Jobfradrag rate
amounts.threshold_note: Calculated on income above the job deduction threshold.

amounts.label: Jobfradrag income threshold
amounts.threshold_note: Income above this amount enters the job deduction calculation.

amounts.label: Senior employment deduction rate
amounts.threshold_note: For people in employment with 1 or 2 years until state pension age.

amounts.label: Single-provider extra employment deduction maximum
amounts.threshold_note: For qualifying single providers receiving extra child benefit.

rules.title: Kørselsfradrag / befordringsfradrag for 2026
rules.summary: Commuting deduction is available when daily transport to and from paid work exceeds 24 km in total. On the annual statement it is entered in rubrik 51; on the preliminary assessment it uses field 417. The taxpayer must use actual commuting days and exclude home-working days, holidays, sick days, and similar days.
rules.applies_to: Taxpayers with paid work subject to labour market contribution and qualifying commuting distance.
rules.caveats: No deduction if the employer pays transport, if a company car is available, for unpaid internship, or for normal study travel except special 2026 island/outer-municipality cases.

amounts.label: 0-24 km per day
amounts.threshold_note: No deduction for the first 24 km of daily commuting.

amounts.label: 25-120 km per day in outer municipalities and certain small islands

return_fields.description: Annual statement field for commuting deduction.

rules.title: Work travel deduction for 2026
rules.summary: Work travel deduction can cover food, lodging, and small necessities when the employer does not cover expenses or pays less than the tax-free standard rates. The trip must involve a temporary workplace, sufficient distance from home, at least 24 hours, and overnight stay away from home.
rules.applies_to: Employees with qualifying temporary work travel and unreimbursed or under-reimbursed travel costs.
rules.caveats: Special groups cannot use all or part of the deduction. B-income recipients cannot use standard rates and must use documented expenses.

amounts.label: Annual travel deduction cap
amounts.threshold_note: Cap when using standard rates; documented-expense rules differ for self-employed people.

amounts.label: Food and small necessities standard rate
amounts.threshold_note: For employees other than special driver categories.

amounts.label: Tourist driver food rate in Denmark
Small necessities 25 percent amount
amounts.threshold_note: 25 percent of the 2026 food standard rate.

rules.title: Servicefradrag and håndværkerfradrag for 2026
rules.summary: Service and crafts deductions are per person and only cover labour costs, not materials. The person must be at least 18 and tax-liable in Denmark, payment must be digital, and documentation must be available.
rules.applies_to: Households with qualifying service or crafts labour expenses.
rules.source_title: Generelle betingelser for håndværkerfradrag og servicefradrag
rules.caveats: Only certain work qualifies. Check the official list of eligible service and crafts work before entering an amount.

rules.title: Aktieindkomst threshold and aktiesparekonto limit for 2026
rules.summary: 2026 progression threshold for aktieindkomst, above which the higher share income rate applies, and the deposit limit for an aktiesparekonto.
rules.applies_to: Individuals with share income or an aktiesparekonto in 2026.
rules.source_title: Beløbsgrænser i skattelovgivningen der reguleres efter personskattelovens § 20 - 2026-2027
rules.caveats: Only the thresholds are seeded, not the share income or aktiesparekonto tax rates. Check how the threshold applies to married couples on skat.dk.

amounts.threshold_note: Maks. fradrag for gaver til almenvelgørende institutioner mv. (LL § 8 A).

rules.summary: 2027 thresholds for mellemskat, topskat and toptopskat, the capital income base amount, and the personfradrag, indexed 2.9 percent from 2026 under personskattelovens § 20.
rules.applies_to: Individuals with taxable personal income in Denmark in 2027.

rules.title: Livsvarig livrente contribution deduction for 2026
rules.summary: Private lifetime annuity contributions up to the annual fill-up deduction amount are automatically transferred to the annual tax assessment. Higher contributions must be reported by the taxpayer to claim the deduction.
rules.applies_to: Taxpayers making private contributions to a lifetime annuity pension scheme.
rules.caveats: Deduction treatment above the fill-up amount depends on who pays and timing. Confirm the exact case before acting.

amounts.label: Automatic annual statement transfer threshold
amounts.threshold_note: Contributions up to this amount are automatically transferred to the annual statement.
